verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents a real API and SDK surface. Backups are explicitly available "using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console", and the marketing page offers managing indexes from the console "or stay in the terminal", which implies console/API parity for core operations. Nothing in the pack states that every UI action has an API equivalent: API key permissions are described only as managed "in the Pinecone console", and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. missing for 10: explicit documentation of full UI/API parity, API coverage of console-only admin tasks such as API key permissions and RBAC, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create backups of serverless indexes to protect data, copy indexes, or experiment with configurations using the Pinecone SDK, API, or console.
Monitor performance, explore your data, and manage indexes from a clean, fast console — or stay in the terminal. Your call.
Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure.
